{"id":1825413700,"question_id":4115,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months, 1 week","timestamp":1762717432,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"4 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1825413700/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Distance Between Three Equal Elements I","memory":"28.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minimumDistance(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int ans = -1;\n        int mini = INT_MAX;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = i+1 ; j<nums.size() ; j++)\n            {\n                for(int k = j+1 ; k < nums.size() ; k++)\n                {\n                    if(nums[i] == nums[j] and nums[j] == nums[k])\n                    {\n                        ans = abs(i-j) + abs(j-k) + abs(k-i);\n                        mini = min(mini , ans);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return mini == INT_MAX ? -1 : mini;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-distance-between-three-equal-elements-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1104}
